mapper.select: select c.cart_id,c.user_id,c.product_id,c.quantity,c.created_date, p.producer_id,p.base_category_id,p.name product_name,p.main_image,p.summary,p.status,p.created_date product_created_date,p.updated_date product_updated_date, d.detail_id,d.grade,d.unit_name,d.price,d.stock_qty,d.origin_region,d.harvest_date,d.expire_date,d.detail_desc from cart c, product p, product_detail d where user_id=#{user_id} and c.product_id=p.product_id and c.product_id=d.product_id order by created_date desc
select count(*) from cart where user_id=#{user_id}
